A [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] '''species''' existed with a dexterous anatomy that included a head and a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] torso with two thin [[Limb/Legends|arms]] and long, wiry fingers. Their head featured two [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], two [[Nose/Legends|nostrils]], and a [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]], with a long neck connecting their head to their chest.<ref name="CCG" />

The [[Species/Legends|species]] was renowned for travelers. [[Brangus Glee]], a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] elder of the species with [[Color/Legends|brown]] skin, originated from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dor Nameth]]. Glee frequented [[Casino/Legends|casinos]] and [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="CCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|'The thinker' among aliens?|''Star Wars: Chronicles'' caption of an image of "Alien 23," referencing the famous statue|<ref name="SWC">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref>}}
As revealed in the [[1997]] reference book [[Star Wars Chronicles|''Star Wars: Chronicles'']], the species' origins date back to the production stages of the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], as one of several [[Alien/Legends|alien]] maquettes constructed for possible usage in the scenes taking place in [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]]. The maquette, known as "Alien 23," was among those scrapped before the film's production. An accompanying image caption in ''Star Wars: Chronicles'' compared the alien to [[Wikipedia:The Thinker|''The Thinker'']], a famous real-life statue.<ref name="SWC" /> The maquette for Alien 23 had been sculpted by [[Ken Ralston]].<ref name="Indiana">{{YouTube|video=kzWqHmjdZZ0|text=BTS - Return of the Jedi's Creatures &#124; Full Panel #indianacomicconvention #starwarshistory #rotj|channel=@FanXComicConventions|name=FanX Comic Conventions|date=2025-03-29}}</ref>

In [[1998]], the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game's]] ''[[Special Edition Limited]]'' expansion set released the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/SpecialEdition-Dark/large/brangusglee.gif "Brangus Glee" card], which featured an image of the alien superimposed in a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] background, thus bringing the species into [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[canon]].<ref name="CCG" />
